clue.text: Drink, and gather one's entry may be barred by this

definitions.text: entry may be barred by this

parts.note: port is a fortified wine, a drink
to cull is to gather or pick out, as flowers or facts
one is I, and the 's stands for 'is', abbreviated to S, giving I and S

explanation.surface: Someone has a drink and gathers themselves, though the door to their place may be locked against them.
explanation.walkthrough: One's reads as I'S, with the apostrophe-s standing for 'is'. The definition is a description: a castle gateway is barred by this grille.
explanation.definitionFit: A castle's gateway was closed by a heavy grated gate lowered in grooves, blocking any entrance.

clue.text: Trophy wives ultimately accepted job

indicators.note: accepted means taken in, so the cup word holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a pot is slang for a trophy or cup won in competition

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word wives

explanation.surface: A trophy wife finally takes on paid work.
explanation.definitionFit: A post is a position of employment, a synonym for a job.

clue.text: The acts of a con man on holiday in tears

definitions.text: The acts of a con man

indicators.note: in places the holiday word inside the word for tears

parts.note: tears, as in rends, are rips
someone on holiday is off work

explanation.surface: A swindler works his tricks while on holiday, reducing victims to tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tears' reads as weeping, but it is rips in cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Swindles and frauds carried out by a trickster are informally called by this plural noun.

clue.text: Declares ketch must be renovated to get ready for action

indicators.note: renovated means remade, telling us to rebuild the letters of the two fodder words in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone announces that a two-masted sailing boat needs refitting before going to sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of DECLARES and KETCH together are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A naval idiom: warships cleared their decks before battle, so the phrase now means prepare for action.

clue.text: Get better tho' losing heart and respect

parts.note: things look up when they improve

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letter of the short word is dropped

parts.note: tho' is the clipped spelling of though

explanation.surface: A grumble that, for all the improvement, someone has lost courage yet still deserves esteem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing heart' removes H, the middle of THO, leaving TO.
explanation.definitionFit: To admire and hold someone in esteem is an idiomatic phrasal verb meaning respect.

clue.text: Children? A bone of contention

definitions.meaning: offspring, as in dying without children
a matter in dispute, a point at stake

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both offspring in legal language and a subject being argued over.

clue.text: Cornish sailor's mop?

parts.note: Cornwall lies in the South-West of England, abbreviated SW
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: Is this a West Country seaman's mop?
explanation.walkthrough: Cornwall is the county at the far south-western tip of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A swab is a mop used for cleaning a ship's deck, so the question mark hints at the sailor link.

clue.text: A rhyme for really dangerous move on bike?

definitions.text: A rhyme for really dangerous move on bike?

parts.words: A rhyme for really dangerous move on bike?
parts.note: the stunt word rhymes with 'really', and a cyclist riding on the back wheel alone is a risky move

explanation.surface: A request for a word that rhymes with really, describing a daring cycling stunt.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works twice: the answer rhymes with 'really', and it names a risky trick on a bike.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding with the front wheel lifted off the ground is the stunt the clue describes.

clue.text: Dominating prime equestrian activity?

parts.note: prime means the best, of the highest quality
riding horses is an equestrian activity

explanation.surface: Excelling at the finest horsemanship.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestride is to stand over and dominate, as a colossus straddles the world.

clue.text: Head honcho more worried by son getting out of bed

parts.note: someone who has got out of bed is up

indicators.note: worried means shaken about, so the four letters of more are jumbled

explanation.surface: The big boss is more anxious when his son gets up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting out of bed' reads as part of the son's story, but it simply means up; 'worried' is the anagram signal, not a mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is the person in overall charge, the top boss.

clue.text: Blocks put on spy's cover and methods

indicators.note: the cover of a word is its outside letters, first and last

parts.note: to stem a flow is to block it

explanation.surface: Barriers are placed over a secret agent's false identity and working practices.
explanation.definitionFit: Systems are organised ways of doing things, the same idea as procedures.

clue.text: Two ways in which Forest has one means of advancement

indicators.note: in which tells us the forest sits inside the pair of roads

parts.note: ST, street, is a way; two of them give ST and ST
ST, street, is a way; two of them give ST and ST
Epping Forest is an ancient woodland on the north-eastern edge of London
taken as written

explanation.surface: A football club called Forest has two ways of making progress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forest' suggests Nottingham Forest football club, but it is Epping Forest, an ancient woodland bordering north-east London.
explanation.definitionFit: A step on the way to a goal is figuratively one of the stones laid across a stream.

clue.text: Person who anticipates exciting flutter on reel?

indicators.note: exciting means stirring up, so these letters are agitated into a new order

explanation.surface: A gambler's thrill at a bet on a fishing reel, or a dance?
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of FLUTTER, ON and REEL are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A clairvoyant who predicts the future is someone who anticipates what will happen.

clue.text: Mafia boss pinching most of Italian composer's drink

indicators.note: pinching means gripping, so the boss word holds the composer inside

parts.note: a capo is the head of a Mafia family

indicators.note: most of means the last letter of the composer's name is dropped

parts.note: Puccini wrote the operas Tosca and La Bohème

explanation.surface: A Mafia chief steals the Italian composer's coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: A frothy espresso coffee topped with steamed milk is the drink named.

clue.text: Vacant home in estate redesigned for arty type

indicators.note: in places the emptied home inside the rearranged estate
redesigned means remodelled, so the letters of estate are rearranged
vacant means emptied, so only the outside letters of the word remain

explanation.surface: An empty house on a remodelled housing development suits a lover of art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vacant' keeps only the outside letters of the home word; 'redesigned' signals the letters of estate are rearranged, and 'in' puts the emptied home inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: An aesthete is someone devoted to beauty and the arts, an arty type.

clue.text: American farm butter?

definitions.meaning: in the US a large farm or ranch is called a ...
butter is something ... on bread, a ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word is US slang for a ranch and also names any paste such as butter put on toast.

clue.text: Choke, getting most of the rubbish left out with no end of grief

indicators.note: most of means the final letter of the short word is dropped

parts.note: rot is rubbish, nonsense

indicators.note: out signals the remaining letters are put out of order
with no tells us a letter is removed from the word left
end of picks out the last letter of the word grief

explanation.surface: Someone chokes on most of the rubbish left outside, the grief unending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of grief' removes F from LEFT, leaving LET, which 'out' rearranges as TLE; TH and ROT come first.
explanation.definitionFit: To throttle someone is to strangle them, so it is a synonym of choke as a verb.

clue.text: Pole in wages spoof

indicators.note: in places the pole inside the wages word

parts.note: pay is wages
a rod is a pole

explanation.surface: A Polish worker's wage is mocked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a person from Poland, but it is a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A parody is a comic imitation, the same thing as a spoof.

clue.text: Coarse fish covering late-starting meal

indicators.note: covering means the fish wraps around the other piece

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish

indicators.note: late-starting means the meal word has lost its first letter

parts.note: lunch is a midday meal

explanation.surface: A rough fish dish is served at a meal that started late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'late-starting' sounds like a meal served late, but it means the meal word is missing its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Raunchy means earthy and vulgar, which is to say coarse or crude.

clue.text: Toast feature applied to most of country

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature

indicators.note: most of means the last letter of the country is dropped

parts.note: China is a country

explanation.surface: A face is pressed against a map of almost the whole of a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Chin-chin is a dated British drinking toast, like cheers.

clue.text: Bothered, but is in possession of transport in the north

parts.note: to be in possession of something is to have it, so has
a sled is the vehicle used over snow in the far north

explanation.surface: Annoyed, but owns a vehicle for snowy northern climes.

clue.text: Sound advice — forty per cent of hotel employs rented accommodation

indicators.note: sound tells us the advice word is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: employs means uses

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning wise, but it tells you to hear the advice word.
explanation.definitionFit: Council houses are homes owned by a local authority and let to tenants for rent.

clue.text: A step away from so-called gerrymandering

indicators.note: away from tells us to take the letters out of the words that follow

explanation.definitionFit: A ledge is a narrow shelf, like a step in a rock face.

clue.text: A horse's name for a man

parts.note: a dam is the mother of a horse, the female parent

explanation.surface: A horse is given a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Adam is a man's first name, and in the Bible the first man.

clue.text: Cut poor decisions — not so!

not tells us the letters of so are left out of the pool

explanation.definitionFit: Incised means carved or engraved, so a mark that is cut into a surface.

clue.text: Stepped across line and the French caused bother on the internet

indicators.note: across means spanning, so the walking word straddles the other pieces

parts.note: trod is the past tense of tread, stepped
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French traveller crossed a line and stirred up trouble online.
explanation.definitionFit: To troll is to post provocative messages online, so this past tense means caused bother there.

clue.text: Duck confronting really disheartened and cross creature

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nought, O

parts.note: a cross is the letter X

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a duck is a score of zero, read as the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: An oryx is a large straight-horned antelope, a creature.

clue.text: Vote's close, amid signs of hesitation by adjudicator

parts.note: ref, short for referee, is an adjudicator

indicators.note: amid means among, so the close word sits between the two hesitation sounds

parts.note: er is a sound of hesitation
um is another sound of hesitation
a close is an end
